DIP28_JEDEC_SRAM_8K.name: JEDEC 28-pin SRAM/FRAM 8K (6264/FM1608 family)
DIP28_JEDEC_SRAM_8K.comment: Standard JEDEC parallel SRAM/FRAM 28-pin layout. Same address bus as DIP28_2764 (A0-A12 at pins 10,9,...,2 — 13 address bits for 8K). Differs from DIP28_2764 at: pin 1 = NC (vs VPP), pin 27 = !WE (vs !PGM), pin 26 = NC. Used by 6264-class SRAM and Ramtron FM1608 FRAM. Tentative — bench-validation required for chip-specific layouts.

DIP32_STD.name: JEDEC 32-Pin Standard
DIP32_STD.comment: Standard 32-pin UV-EPROM layout (27C010/27C020/27C040 family). VPP on pin 1, PGM (where applicable) on pin 31; A18 takes over pin 31 on 27C040. NOT correct for 5V flash (AM29F040/SST39SF040 family — those have A18 at pin 1, WE at pin 31 — see DIP32_SST39SF040).

DIP32_SST39SF040.name: JEDEC 32-pin 5V Flash (SST39SF040/AM29F040 family)
DIP32_SST39SF040.comment: Per piersfinlayson/one-rom (datasheet-verified): SST39SF040 and same-family 4Mbit/8Mbit 5V flash chips have A18 at pin 1 (NOT VPP) and WE at pin 31 (NOT address bus). Distinct from DIP32_STD (UV-EPROM 27C040 layout) where pins 1 and 31 are swapped. Covers ~47 chips at (pin_count=32, pm_idx=13, protocol_id=0x06): AM29F040, SST39SF040, A29040, EN29F040, MX29F040, etc. — all 5V single-supply flash.

DIP28_28C256.name: JEDEC 28-pin 5V parallel EEPROM (28C256 family)
DIP28_28C256.comment: Per piersfinlayson/one-rom (datasheet-verified): 28C256 family has 15 address pins (A0-A14), with A14 at pin 1 (NOT VPP) and WE at pin 27 (NOT PGM). 5V single-supply, no programming voltage. Distinct from DIP28_2764 (UV-EPROM layout) which has VPP at pin 1 and PGM at pin 27. Covers ~8 chips at (pin_count=28, pm_idx=20, protocol_id=0x07): AT28C256, AT28C256E/F, HN58C256, HN58C256AP, etc. Routes through configure_eeprom28c after WARNING-5 algo override OR directly via pm_idx-based pinout selection.

DIP24_6116.name: JEDEC 24-pin 5V SRAM (6116/6264-style)
DIP24_6116.comment: Per piersfinlayson/one-rom (datasheet-verified): 6116 SRAM has 11 address pins (A0-A10) with A10=pin 19, CE=18, OE=20, WE=21. 5V single-supply, no programming voltage. Used by 6116-class 2KB SRAM chips. Covers the (pin_count=24, pm_idx=0, protocol_id=0x27) group + any other JEDEC 24-pin SRAM/FRAM with 6116-compatible pinout.

DIP24_2816.name: JEDEC 24-pin 5V parallel EEPROM (AT28C16/AT28C04 family)
DIP24_2816.comment: AT28C16/AT28C04/28C16A-class 24-pin 5V single-supply parallel EEPROMs. Same physical layout as DIP24_6116 SRAM (WE=pin 21, OE=pin 20, CE=pin 18, VCC=pin 24, GND=pin 12). NO vpp-pin — configure_eeprom28c is 5V-only (SDP-disable + DQ7 page-write polling; VPP regulator is never asserted). Over-allocated to A0-A10 (11 address bits = AT28C16 maximum); AT28C04 has 9 address lines and firmware restricts driving via mem_size. Source: Atmel AT28C16 datasheet Table 1 (pin description). Pin 21=WE, NOT VPP — the DIP24_2716 (UV-EPROM) layout has VPP=pin 21; this layout does NOT.

DIP28_28C64.name: JEDEC 28-pin 5V parallel EEPROM 8K (28C64 family)
DIP28_28C64.comment: Per piersfinlayson/one-rom (datasheet-verified): 28C64 has 13 address pins (A0-A12, same as 2764 EPROM), CE=20, OE=22, WE=27, pin 1=NC (or /busy on some variants). 5V single-supply, no programming voltage. Distinct from DIP28_2764 (UV-EPROM layout) — pin 27 is WE (not PGM), pin 1 is NC (not VPP). Covers (pin_count=28, pm_idx=19, protocol_id=0x07) group: AM28C64A/B/E, etc. Routes through configure_eeprom28c via WARNING-5 algo flip.

DIP32_28C512_EEPROM.name: JEDEC 32-pin 5V parallel EEPROM 64K (28C512 family)
DIP32_28C512_EEPROM.comment: Per piersfinlayson/one-rom (datasheet-verified): 28C512 has 16 address pins (A0-A15) with A15=pin 3, data bus on pins 13,14,15,17-21, CE=22, OE=24, WE=30, no VPP. 5V single-supply. Used by 32-pin 5V parallel EEPROMs (64K class). Covers (pin_count=32, pm_idx=9, protocol_id=0x0D) group: CAT28C512, CAT28C010 (note CAT28C010 is 64K despite name due to 16-bit organization), etc. Also reasonable default for 32-pin SRAM/NVRAM (M48Tx) with similar physical layout, though those use byte-write semantics rather than EEPROM page-write.
